title: Carbon Pricing MRV Gap Analysis — Nepal
description: Institutional MRV mapping, reporting architecture, verification pathways, and registry/compliance logic for Nepal's carbon pricing framework. Reviews monitoring, reporting, and verification gaps across key sectors.

title: Community Cookstove Programme — Impact Assessment
description: Field assessment of electric cookstove programme outcomes across 1,000+ households in rural Nepal — adoption constraints, fuel savings, indoor air quality improvements, and emission reductions.

title: HKH Energy-Shock Geospatial Analysis
description: Interactive district-level mapping of the Hindu Kush Himalaya region combining an Energy Tier Index (ETI) and Climate Shock Index (CSI) — explore energy vulnerability across the region.
